name: Leedarson IoT Technology Inc.
summary: Operating globally, Leedarson IoT Technology Inc. specializes in the development and manufacture of diverse Internet of Things (IoT) products. Their offerings additionally span lighting solutions, including LED light sources, LED lamps, and energy-efficient fluorescent lamps. The company's comprehensive portfolio features smart home products such as control systems, sensors, IP cameras (IPC), smart lighting, and connected modules, as well as solutions for smart buildings. They also provide integrated systems for home security, video surveillance, and automation. Founded in 2000, the firm, headquartered in Xiamen, China, operated as Xiamen Leedarson Lighting Group Co., Ltd. until officially adopting its current name, Leedarson IoT Technology Inc., in January 2020.
